flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democrats to take the Senate improved moderately, with the party remaining the market's favoured side. In [[Michigan]], the Democrat Abdul El-Sayed gained moderate ground. In [[Nebraska]], the Republican Pete Ricketts saw a moderate drop in their chances.
summaries.governor: Three governor's races saw moderate gains for the leader, all of them shown as predicted flips: [[Georgia]], where the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained ground, [[Kansas]], where the Republican Ty Masterson improved, and [[Alaska]], where the Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins moved up. In Texas, the Republican Greg Abbott also saw a moderate rise in Polymarket odds.
summaries.house: The biggest move was in [[NC-03 (Greenville & Jacksonville)]], where the Republican, Greg Murphy, saw a sharp drop in Polymarket odds against the Democrat Raymond Smith Jr. In [[MO-02 (O'Fallon & Chesterfield)]], the Republican Ann Wagner also lost ground by a moderate amount, with the Democrat being Fred Wellman. Going the other way, the Republican Anna Paulina Luna in [[FL-13 (Clearwater & Largo)]] gained a moderate amount of ground over the Democrat Leela Gray.
